title: Quote oda da kyau, kiyaye inganci, bin lambobi shida
course_title: Kasuwancin Mata da Ci gaban Kananan Kasuwanci

say: Quote oda da kyau, kiyaye inganci, da bin lambobi shida.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na biyu na Kasuwancin Mata da Ci gaban Kananan Kasuwanci.
Kasuwancin haɓaka suna sayar da oda: tiren liyafa, saitin riguna, akwatunan ƙwai don otal. Idan ka faɗi daga al'ada, babban tsari zai iya sa ka shagala da talauci a lokaci guda.

say: Ga misalin aiki. Abokin ciniki zai biya ta hanyar hanyar biyan kuɗi.
Kayayyakin sun kai naira 38,500. Marufi shine fakiti 50 akan naira 250 kowanne, haka 12,500.
Gas, bayarwa da mataimaki na ranar suna ƙara 14,000. Nata awa 10 akan naira 1000 ta kara 10,000.
Jimlar kudin, Naira 75,000. Naira 1,500 kenan a kowace fakiti.
Margin riba ne a matsayin rabon farashin. Aisha tana son kashi 25, kuma kudin linke kashi 1.5 ne. Don haka 75,000 aka raba da 0.735 ya ba da kusan naira 102,041.

say: Rubuta matakan ku a shafi ɗaya, tare da duban kowa zai iya yi: lokaci, nauyi, ƙidaya. Sannan bin diddigin adadin korafinku: korafe-korafen da aka raba ta hanyar umarni, sau 100.

say: Don abinci, bi Maɓallai biyar na WHO don Amintaccen Abinci: kiyaye tsabta, ware danye da dafaffe, dafa sosai, kiyaye yanayin zafi, da amfani da ruwa mai tsafta.

panel.heading: Tushen aminci yayin da kuke girma

cards.d: Tsaftace, raba danye da dafaffe, dafa sosai, kiyaye yanayin zafi, amfani da ruwa mai tsafta.
Sanya iska, duba hoses da ruwan sabulu, kar a bar mai mai zafi, kar a cika kwasfa.
Koyaushe a waje, nesa da kofofi, tagogi da filaye. Turin hayaki ba shi da wari kuma yana iya kashewa.

say: Tare da iskar gas, dafa a cikin sarari mai iska, bincika hoses don ɗigon ruwa da ruwan sabulu, da ajiye bargon wuta ko kashe wuta a kusa. Kada a yi fiye da kima, kuma ka nisanta ƙarfe daga ruwa.

say: Rubuta lambobi shida iri ɗaya kowane wata: kudaden shiga, babban riba, ribar net, tsabar kuɗi a ƙarshen wata, maimaita ƙimar abokin ciniki, da sa'o'in ku.
Kalli riba da tsabar kuɗi gefe da gefe. Ribar kwai Titi ya tashi zuwa naira 105,000 a wata uku, amma har yanzu wani otal yana bin ta bashin 180,000 na kwai, don haka kudinta ya fadi.
Yawancin ƙananan kamfanoni masu riba suna rufe saboda sun ƙare da kuɗi. Ƙare kowane bita da rubutaccen aiki ɗaya.

say: Ka tuna. Kidaya duka layukan farashi shida. Yi amfani da dabarar gefe, ɗauki ajiya, kuma tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku.
Rubuta ma'aunin ku don mataimaki ya bi ta, kuma ku bibiyar lambobi shida kowane wata.

say: Quote daya ainihin oda tare da duk shida farashin layukan. Rubuta takardar ingancin ku kuma fara rajistan ƙararrawa. Sannan gina dashboard na watanni ukun da suka gabata kuma a kewaya mafi rauni lamba.
Yanzu ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
